dimensions.assessment: Affects manufacturers of biological and biosimilar products, Medicare beneficiaries, and federal administration of drug price negotiations.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title XI of the Social Security Act to alter when biosimilar biological products are eligible for price negotiations under the Medicare program.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies negotiation delay criteria, automatic delay triggers, and potential rebate calculations for reference biological products.
dimensions.evidence: the manufacturer of such biological product shall pay a rebate under paragraph (4) with respect to the years for which such manufacturer would have provided access

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts Medicare drug price negotiation timelines, potential price applicability periods, and manufacturer rebate structures.
dimensions.evidence: 75 percent of the amount by which the average manufacturer price... exceeds... the maximum fair price negotiated under section 1194

dimensions.assessment: Amends section 1192 of the Social Security Act by altering statutory formulas, evidentiary requirements, and procedures for drug price negotiations.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1192 of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1320f-1) is amended...

dimensions.assessment: Applies permanently starting with initial price applicability year 2027.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply with respect to initial price applicability years beginning with initial price applicability year 2027.

missing_information: Net federal budgetary savings or costs resulting from the altered negotiation timelines.
importance_detail.rationale: Alters the timeline and criteria under the Medicare program for when biosimilar biological products trigger price negotiation delays or rebates for reference products.
